name: ICIJ Offshore Leaks Database (reconciliation API and bulk CSV)
tier_rationale: Established non-profit journalism consortium publishing the database with documented reconciliation API and bulk download, ODbL/CC BY-SA terms (A8 trusted); P221 provider tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Journalistically curated leak-derived records (Panama, Paradise, Pandora Papers, Offshore and Bahamas Leaks); presence is not evidence of wrongdoing and homonyms are common, so name matches stay POSSIBLE (P221 cond 6).

reconcile.title: ICIJ Offshore Leaks reconciliation API (POST /api/v1/reconcile, OpenRefine protocol; entity-typed, at most 5 candidates)

terms.quote: ODbL/CC BY-SA are met by runtime download and attribution, so terms are open (A1).

reconcile.notes: Quote: binding council text (P221 chair rationale). Research C0516: POST answers 201 with scored candidates {id, name, description (the leak), score, match, types}. Used only by icij_offshore_api, without the local index and only at TLP:CLEAR/GREEN or on explicit selection (P221 cond 4). The web search page (202 + AWS WAF JS challenge) is never fetched (cond 7). Undocumented limits: self-imposed 250 POSTs/day (80% = 200) and 2 s between requests. Batch p3-G10-1.

bulk.title: ICIJ Offshore Leaks bulk CSV (full-oldb.LATEST.zip: entities, officers, intermediaries, relationships)

terms.quote: Local first: the bulk CSV (ODbL database + CC BY-SA contents, several hundred MB) is imported into SQLite only by `v3lum data update icij` through the dataset manager, never bundled (A6) and never downloaded during a scan.

bulk.notes: Quote: binding council text (P221 cond 3). offshoreleaks-data.icij.org/offshoreleaks/csv/full-oldb.LATEST.zip (~72 MB compressed, ~626 MB of CSV, generated 2026-09-09). The address member is never imported (cond 2). Used by icij_offshore (disclosure none). Batch p3-G10-1.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G10-1 (P221). Attribution (ODbL database + CC BY-SA contents) travels with every result (attribute data_attribution) and the notice fragment icij_offshore_leaks.
